Question Choices: Solve a - 12 = 19 and find the value of a
Hints: Use the same inverse operation on both sides; combine like terms first when needed.
Solution: Add 12 on both sides to undo the constant: a=19+(12)=31. Check: left side (31) - 12=19; right side 19=19. The two sides agree.

Question Choices: Solve equation with decimals K - 6 = 13.5 and find the value of K
Hints: Use the same inverse operation on both sides; combine like terms first when needed.
Solution: Add 6 on both sides to undo the constant: K=13.5+(6)=19.5. Check: left side (19.5) - 6=13.5; right side 13.5=13.5. The two sides agree.

Question Choices: Solve equation with fractions (4/11) = T - (5/11) and find the value of T
Hints: Use the same inverse operation on both sides; combine like terms first when needed.
Solution: Add 5/11 on both sides to undo the constant: T=4/11+(5/11)=9/11. Using denominator 11: (4+(5))/11=9/11, in simplest form. Check: left side (4/11)=4/11; right side (9/11) - (5/11)=4/11. The two sides agree.

Question Choices: Solve y - 12 = -35 and find the value of y
Hints: Use the same inverse operation on both sides; combine like terms first when needed.
Solution: Add 12 on both sides to undo the constant: y=-35+(12)=-23. Check: left side (-23) - 12=-35; right side -35=-35. The two sides agree.
